name: Silver Snake
source:
The dragon god of the Autumn Village.

Kikyo is ordered by his father, the Autumn Village chieftain, to become the Silver Snake's medium before he can become his father's successor.

The Silver Snake appears primarily in Kikyo's route and spin-offs.
